evidenceNotes: No sales, actual customer-support data, AI containment evaluation or vendor invoice. This is a stage-based operating design.
Public rates are current; usage, service productivity and budgets are assumptions. No billing session was reopened.
Founder cash wages are zero in the bootstrapped cash view; all direct support/ops and R&D/growth/admin time remain visible in economic views.
Gross margin includes production hosting, variable delivery and imputed direct support/ops, never marketing or feature development.
Ads default to zero as a spending policy, not zero CAC or guaranteed AI acquisition. CAC remains unavailable without real acquired-payer counts.

Legal/tax/merchant/security obligations precede real launch regardless of customer count. The one-time1000–3000 review reserve is unquoted and does not guarantee completion; widen or remain synthetic if actual requirements exceed it.
